NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VII: KNOWLEDGE, CONSENT AND SHARED WORK (LCG-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)

collection.description: Several families built a canoe together and now argue over who uses it first: take turns by lot, or by need.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Six families built the great canoe together, and now it is finished, and all six want to take it out first. (subject) says the order should be drawn by lot. (friend) says the family whose own canoe was lost in the storm should go first, and every week after. What should the families decide?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They draw shells from a basket. The family that wins is the one that did the least work, and everyone knows it. They take the canoe out anyway, sheepishly, and bring back a huge catch, which they share with everyone.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The family who lost their canoe goes first, and every week until theirs is replaced. The others agree, mostly. When the new canoe is finished, all six families paddle the great canoe out together, too many people in it, nearly sinking.
